## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak sector breadth and mixed leadership (Healthcare/Financials/Energy leading while Technology is broadly weak), plus major large-cap divergences. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Healthcare in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: MPC (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +7.01%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. Financials mixed but constructive: WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, BAC (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +0.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary under pressure: TSLA (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.61% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY, ABT (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +5.53%) ABOVE TREND, WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, CVS (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +10.44%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Healthcare).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -9.63% | 1M: +10.68%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -10.04% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -20.93%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and Industrials names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: MDT (1W: +10.65%), DE (1W: +7.61%), ABT (1W: +6.39%), WFC (1W: +5.67%), CVS (1W: +5.44%) — momentum focused in Healthcare, Industrials and Financials. Major divergence present: big-cap techs AAPL (CORRECTION), MSFT (CORRECTION) and JPM (RECOVERY) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — this is a MAJOR DIVERGENCE, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology is weak and uneven; NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.46% | 1M: +0.87%) CORRECTION, AAPL (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%) CORRECTION — sector breadth negative and subject to leadership rotation. Sector breadth (overall): 4/11 sectors positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive but not uniform; WFC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +2.47%) ABOVE TREND, BAC (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +0.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY — favors selective financial exposure while monitoring earnings/credit signals.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is the clearest leadership pocket: UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +14.82%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.30% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND — sector showing accumulation and defensive rotation characteristics.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Healthcare and selective Energy/Financials given above-trend names; reduce exposure to structurally weak large-cap Technology names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — remain selective and monitor the large-cap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MDT (1W: +10.65% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +1.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -13.52% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -10.28% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth positive within sector), Energy (showing strength). BEARISH: Technology (broad 1W weakness), Communication (continuing negative momentum).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for hold/break of recent monthly lows as trigger for further downside (NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND). Watch AAPL (1W: -1.51% | 1M: +7.00%) CORRECTION for reversion back above its 1M trend. Watch UNH (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +8.76%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above recent resistance to confirm sector leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+65): SpaceX cloud deal headline; GOOGL (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -7.41%) BELOW TREND — sentiment positive but price not confirming (distribution risk). NVDA (+60): AI deal headlines; NVDA (1W: -2.75% | 1M: -1.20%) BELOW TREND — news supportive but price remains below trend, watch for accumulation. BA (+55): certification testing phase; BA (1W: -6.79% | 1M: -6.30%) BELOW TREND — sentiment improving but price still weak.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-60): TurboTax probe; INTU (1W: -10.49% | 1M: -23.62%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm downside risk. SHOP (-60): scrutiny headline; SHOP not showing in top lists here — monitor for follow-through if in exposure. PM (-50): earnings/guidance hit; PM not in detailed excerpt — watch for confirmation in price action if held.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MDT, UNH, XOM showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while NVDA, MSFT, AAPL showing weakness (BELOW TREND / CORRECTION). Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps and tech sentiment vs price (NVDA +60 news vs NVDA BELOW TREND) — monitor for clear trend confirmation before committing new core exposure.
